record.name: Monaco
record.summary: No qualifying institute or commitment identified. The official Data Programme job specification covers government AI projects from needs assessment to deployment and implementation for administrative and public-service needs. It does not designate an institute to evaluate advanced AI models for their capabilities or behaviour risks.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English results did not identify a qualifying institute or institute-specific commitment, proposal or government study. The existing official Data Programme job specification covers data governance and implementation of administrative/public-service AI projects. Its technology-evaluation language does not establish severe-risk testing of general-purpose or frontier models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Aligned current rationale wording with the consolidated capability-or-behaviour-risk test, removing the old severity requirement. This editorial consistency pass adds no research claim and does not change status or the last full-check date.

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The government's data programme assigns coordination and supervision of government data and AI projects; this is deployment governance rather than evaluation of the safety of advanced models.

record.notes: Read the official January 2025 recruitment notice setting out the Data Programme responsibilities. The official October 2024 Wealth-Tech Summit page was returned as a search extract but timed out on opening, so it is not relied upon as a read source. Search hits concerning EuropIA were not evidence of national government designation. No qualifying institute, commitment or institute-specific study found; a deployment job specification cannot prove absence. Previous broad-search source retained.
